lines: Mehfil mein baar baar kisi par nazar gayi
couplets.en: All evening, my eyes kept straying to someone.

lines: Hum ne bachayi laakh magar phir udhar gayi
couplets.en: Try as I might, my gaze wandered back.

lines: Baar baar kisi par nazar gayi
couplets.en: Again and again, my eyes found the same face.
